items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: And at the time, though, that Emanuel was very popular with the piano, too. And he played the clarinet to give me a chance at the piano, you see.

ctx.x: So I've always been well chaperoned. Yeah. And at the time, though, that Emanuel was very popular with the piano, too. And he played the clarinet to give me a chance at the piano, you see. Oh, yeah. Yeah.

You know, he could play all the instruments, and he still does, too. Yeah, he does. Like the other one, there's two instruments at once. I wondered about his piano playing. I've only heard him, of course, the last six or seven years, really, a little longer, maybe. And I never did hear him like about 30 years ago when he used to play all the time. Did he play a much different style? Yes, yes.
